failures.message: ran and passed with its mutant applied to saffron/follow_up.py — `write_follow_ups` reads every head and range from `stack.fields`, with the same fallback for a missing layer. The stack's test paths come from the bottom layer's diff base to the top layer's graded head. The probe check reads the top layer's graded head. Each writer prompt carries its origin layer's diff, from its diff base to its graded head. The prompt names that range, the origin's graded head and the top's graded head. Each in-cell concern's line in the prompt names the origin's packaged head, the head its lines cite. An end-review finding's line names none. A missing top layer and a missing bottom layer each read their packaged head. The witness drives a prompt for each layer of a moved stack, a group holding both kinds of finding, then each missing layer.

payload.summary: 1 of 2 witness(es) survived their own mutant
